name: Cable Single-Arm Reverse-Grip Preacher Curl
steps: Rest one upper arm on a preacher bench facing a low pulley and hold its handle with your palm down.
Bend the supported elbow and lift the handle toward your shoulder.
Straighten your arm under control to lower the handle.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your wrist straight against the pull of the cable.
Keep your upper arm planted on the pad and avoid shrugging your working shoulder.
